steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.phrases: The words come in lines, and each line is a phrase: sing it on one breath, and breathe where the line ends, never in the middle of a word. Shorten the line’s last note a little to make room for a quick, quiet breath.
steps.twinkle: “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star”: each line is two bars long. Breathe after every line, in time with the piano.
steps.ode: “Ode to Joy”: four lines with more words in each, and no rests between them. Take a quick breath at the end of every line, and keep the beat steady.
